# ⚡ git-oops v0.2.0: The Dual-Mode AI Agent Safety Harness & Crash Fixer

We are thrilled to officially unveil **git-oops v0.2.0** — transitioning from an interactive terminal crash roaster into an end-to-end, zero-dependency safety runtime for both human developers and autonomous AI coding agents.

---

### 🌟 Key Highlights & The 20-Pillar Singularity Matrix

- 🧑💻 **Dual-Mode Execution**: Interactive ANSI card UI with cynical staff/chef roasts for humans, and `--agent` / `--json` headless JSON for automated pipelines.
- 🔌 **Native Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Run `git-oops --mcp` to instantly attach to **Claude Desktop**, **Cursor**, **Windsurf**, and **Antigravity**.
- 🛡️ **Blast-Radius Firewall**: Intercepts destructive commands (`rm -rf /`, force-push to `main`, wildcard disk wiping).
- 🛑 **Anti-Thrashing Watchdog**: Detects and halts infinite edit-revert oscillation loops before credits burn out.
- 📉 **Context Squeezer & Secret Redactor**: Compresses 5,000-line stack dumps into 20 high-density lines while auto-masking API credentials (`<REDACTED_SECRET>`).
- 👻 **100% Polyglot Ghost Import Linter**: 0ms static AST/heuristic verification across **Python, JS/TS, Go, Rust, Java/Kotlin, C/C++, PHP, Ruby, .NET (C#/F#/VB), Swift, Dart/Flutter, Scala, Elixir, R, Julia, Perl, Haskell, Zig, Nim, Lua, and Shell** — stopping hallucinated fake libraries dead in their tracks.
- 🪞 **Shadow Workspace Isolation**: Dry-runs risky patches in an ephemeral clone directory before atomic sync.
- ✈️ **Flight Recorder & Time-Machine Rewind**: Full audit trail of agent motivations with 1-click snapshot restoration (`--rewind <id>`).
- 🧬 **Antibody Immunity DB**: Saves verified architectural solutions to prevent recurring bugs across future sessions.
- 🔄 **Anti-Bit-Rot Evolution**: Automated schema and model routing to ensure zero obsolescence across Python releases.

---

### 🚀 Quick Installation
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Hao610/git-oops.git
cd git-oops
pip install -e .
```
